Tag mode

Same game, but outside and running.

There's no secret word in this one. The device only tells each of you whether you're crew or an imposter, and then you go and play. Play somewhere with stuff to hide behind. An open field makes every tag obvious.

Tagging

Imposters knock crew out of the game by tagging them. Only imposters get to tag. If you get tagged, fall over and stay down right where you are, and no wandering off. A player lying on the ground is what everyone calls a body, and it's what starts the next meeting, so if you go and hide instead nobody ever finds out anything.

Ghosts

Once you're tagged you're a ghost, which is just the word for being out and watching. Go quiet, walk off the play area, and never let on who tagged you. You saw them do it, so if ghosts were allowed to talk you would say the name and the game would be over on the spot.

Fake deaths

You're allowed to lie down when nobody has tagged you at all. Crew do it next to somebody they suspect, to see what that person does when they think they're alone. Imposters do it right after a real tag, so it's less obvious who was standing near the body. Everyone faking gets back up at the end of the meeting.

Role only, no word

The two kinds of meeting

A meeting is everyone stopping what they're doing, coming together in one place, and talking about who they think the imposters are. There are two ways one starts.

  • Body meeting. Anyone who finds somebody lying on the ground shouts, and everyone gathers. You get as many of these as you want, and they don't use up the number on the device.
  • Emergency meeting. The kind you call when there's no body and you just want everyone in one place. There's only a set number of them and all of you share the same pile, which is why they run out. An imposter is allowed to call one, and calling one is a decent way to look innocent.

Either kind ends in a vote, and voting is the only way crew ever get an imposter out, because crew can't tag anybody. Argue it out, point at once on three, and whoever has the most votes is out of the game and becomes a ghost. If you can't agree, send nobody out and carry on.

End every meeting the same way

Count out "3, 2, 1, UP!" so that everyone who was lying down without being tagged gets up at the same moment as everybody else. Do it one at a time and the fakers are obvious. Then nobody can tag for 15 seconds, so people get a chance to spread out first.

How long to wait between tags

After an imposter tags somebody they have to wait before they're allowed to tag anyone else. That wait's called the cooldown, and without it one imposter could clear the whole field in half a minute. How long it's depends on how many of you're playing.

PlayersCooldown
3–645 sec
7–1030 sec
11–1520 sec

The device counts it down for you, so nobody has to remember any of this. Once the last card has been looked at, tag mode opens a screen with two big tiles: your emergency meetings on the left, the tag timer on the right. Tap the left one to use up a meeting, tap the right one the moment you tag someone. It takes the number off the table above and adds 10 seconds for every imposter after the first.
